[Problem]{.card-kicker} **Beautiful matrix** [CF 263A · Beautiful Matrix](https://codeforces.com/problemset/problem/263/A){rating="800"}

The $1$ moves one step at a time on an empty grid, so the fewest moves from $(r, c)$ to the centre $(3, 3)$ is the **Manhattan distance** $|r - 3| + |c - 3|$: each move closes the row gap or the column gap by one, and the two gaps are independent. The problem is only "find the one non-zero cell", then a formula.

[Solved in full in @sec-mat-p5-beautiful.]{.card-link}

:::
